chapter: Childhood, first teachers and the Wilberforce Collegians
title: Staging debates to sleep through Prof. David's class
summary: After returning from gigs at 7 am, the band started debates in the psychology class so they could sleep; the professor caught on but accepted it.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: School days: grades, teachers and leaving school

blocks.x: Like we'd get in from Cleveland, Ohio at seven o'clock in the morning, our first class is 7:45. There was a professor there, I'll never forget him, named Prof. David, we called him. And he was a psychology teacher, and were in that -- and most of the time, there would be discussions. We'd get in his class, and we'd start a debate purposely, and after we'd get it started, in about 15 minutes, you could tell the guys in the corner asleep.
The debates are going on, you see. We'd do this, we talked thought this up, It's very terrible, to say this, but -- this is what happened, and it worked.
And -- but one day, professor caught on to it, you know, and he says, "I know what you guys are doing." He says, "It's okay as long as we're getting results." But he was 100 percent.
